name: BrowserPaw M7 browser task suite
note: Fixed inputs only. This suite defines tasks and record contracts; it does not execute agents or synthesize measurements.

recordSchema.conditionIssues: Optional array of nonempty audit reasons. Known mid-trial condition changes or setup defects exclude the record from pairing and efficiency gates, while preserving its actual business outcome and measurements.

viewport.successfulRecords: positive integer width/height and finite positive dpr read back from the same owned page; dpr is not a requested target value
viewport.unobservedFailures: agent_e2e blocked/failure records may store width/height/dpr as null individually; these records never pair or enter speed rankings
viewport.invalidValues: zero, negative, NaN, and Infinity remain invalid
viewport.legacy: records without dpr remain readable but are never pairable

counterSemantics.roundTrips: raw backend MCP tool-call or CLI-process count; never an Agent model round-trip
counterSemantics.agentToolCalls: unique response_item function_call/custom_tool_call call_id count from one Agent session

skillReuse.taskLink: each reuse task's explorationInputId names one distinct earlier cold task in the same family
skillReuse.recordPair: candidate cold and reuse records share an explorationPairId; reuse must start later

actualTokens.input: Codex-reported cumulative input_tokens from the fresh single Agent turn; includes cached input tokens and image tokens when present
actualTokens.output: Codex-reported output_tokens from the same turn
actualTokens.gate: The formal 30% reduction gate compares paired successful actualTokens.input values; null never falls back to an estimate

estimatedTokens.role: Backend cl100k_base text estimates are diagnostic summary fields only; they are not an Agent-context measurement or a formal gate

images.scope: Counts backend returned image blocks only, not images passed to the Agent. Zero does not establish image-free model input; report cumulative Agent input tokens without claiming a text-only split

recordSchema.neutrality: Records must come from real executions. Partial is not success and is excluded from paired speed rankings.
